content.title: Siemens 261-1937 Three Phase Electric Motor, 3 kW, 1450 rpm, Frame 100L, 50 Hz, Class F
content.short_description: Siemens 261-1937 is a three phase electric motor rated 3 kW at 1450 rpm, built on a 100L frame for 50 Hz supply with Class F insulation.
content.long_description:
The Siemens 261-1937 is a three phase electric motor designed for 50 Hz power systems, delivering a rated output of 3 kW at a rated speed of 1450 rpm. It is constructed on a 100L frame size, consistent with standard mounting and shaft dimensions for this power class.

The motor uses Class F insulation, which supports operation at higher winding temperatures than lower insulation classes, relevant when specifying motors for continuous industrial duty.

Use this reference data to confirm compatibility with existing drive trains, mounting plates, and coupling arrangements before installation. Verify frame size and speed against the driven equipment's requirements as part of the selection process.
